metadata.name: Item Weight Editor [EN/CN]
metadata.description:
本MOD刚需 REPENTOGON，目前只支持忏悔，已经测试支持大部分道具MOD
【你大概遇到过这些】
· 某个 mod 的道具运营体验差（比如东方 mod 的交易所门票/D无限），拿到理论无敌，通关，但玩起来不爽 · 某些 mod 组合总有无敌的道具，给的血量太多拿到根本死不掉，或者数值过于超模，没有正常玩游戏的体验 · 想玩得花一点，但随机性不给你机会
这是个很尴尬的局面：不是 mod 做得不好，是它们太强，强到把别的都压平了。
这个 mod 就是来收拾这个局面的——给每个道具单独设一个出现频率。
自定义任意道具的掉落权重。
· 0 = 完全不出现 · 0.5 = 出现率减半 · 1 = 保持原样
【原理】游戏从道具池里抽出某个道具之后，本 mod 会再掷一次骰子，决定要不要把它换成同池子里的另一个。 权重 0.5 就是 50% 概率换掉；权重 0 则必定换掉，所以那个道具再也不会出现。 它不修改道具池本身、不新增道具、不加贴图，只影响"抽到之后要不要换"，所以你身上已有的道具不受影响。
也可以覆盖道具评级 —— 装了 Highlight Review 的话，它的「四级道具」判定会用你设的评级。
【用法】游戏内按 F6 打开，也可以在 ImGui 顶栏 Item Weight → 设置 里改键。 三个入口：搜索 / 已获得道具 / 已修改，可以用道具id或道具英文名进行搜索。
【已知兼容】 · 天界呼唤（Heaven's Call） · 东方系列 · 塔菲的宇宙 · 明日方舟 · 忏悔plus · 愚昧
【注意】 · 权重目前只能降低，不能提高（填 > 1 会保存但不生效）。 提高需要重新分配整个池子的概率，风险大，留到以后做。 · 配置按存档槽保存，1/2/3 号档各自一份。
需要 REPENTOGON。
源码与问题反馈：https://github.com/miopasss/isaac-highlight-review
—————————————————————————
REQUIRES REPENTOGON. Repentance only for now; tested with most item mods.
[You have probably run into this]
· A mod's item is badly paced - e.g. Exchange Ticket / D-infinity from the Touhou mods. Picking it up is theoretically a free win, but the run stops being fun. · Some mod combinations keep handing out items that are simply too strong - they give so much HP you literally cannot die, or the numbers are so inflated the run stops feeling like a game. · You want to play a little more creatively, but the RNG never gives you the chance.
That is an awkward spot: the mods are not badly made, they are just so strong that everything else gets flattened.
This mod exists to fix exactly that - give every item its own appearance rate.
Change how often any item shows up.
· 0 = never appears · 0.5 = half as often · 1 = unchanged
How it works: after the game draws an item from a pool, this mod rolls one more time and decides whether to swap it for another item from the same pool. A weight of 0.5 means a 50% chance of swapping; a weight of 0 always swaps, so the item never shows up. It does not edit the item pools, add items or add graphics - it only affects "what got drawn", so items you already own are unaffected.
It can also override item quality - if Highlight Review is installed, its "quality 4" list uses the ratings you set here.
How to use: press F6 in game, or rebind it in the ImGui menu: Item Weight -> Settings. Three ways to find an item: search / owned items / already modified. You can search by item id or English name.
[Tested with] · Heaven's Call · Touhou series · 塔菲的宇宙 · Arknights (明日方舟) · Repentance+ · 愚昧
[Notes] · Weight can only be lowered, not raised (values above 1 are saved but do nothing). Raising it means redistributing the whole pool, which is risky; left for a later version. · Settings are stored per save slot (save1/2/3 are separate).
Requires REPENTOGON.
Source and issue tracker: https://github.com/miopasss/isaac-highlight-review
